results.title: Mathnasium Singapore's Forum Centre Passes 300 Students as Families Invest Earlier in Maths Foundations
results.description: With a large majority of its Singapore students in kindergarten and primary school, Mathnasium is seeing sustained interest in personalised maths learning that focuses on understanding, number sense and confidence SINGAPORE , Aug. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Recently, Mathnasium Singapore's Forum centre has grown to serve more than 300 students, as families continue to seek maths enrichment that builds strong foundations from an early age. The milestone comes as the large majority of Mathnasium Singapore's students are now of kindergarten and primary school age, reflecting the importance families place on developing mathematical understanding well before major examinations become the main focus. Rather than focusing primarily on repetitive practice or memorising procedures, Mathnasium's approach begins by identifying how each child understands maths, where gaps exist and which concepts require further development. This philosophy is central to the Mathnasium MethodTM, which uses diagnostic assessments and customised learning plans to help students develop mathematical understanding at their own pace. Each student works directly with trained instructors and follows an individual plan based on their strengths, learning gaps and goals. Mathnasium's Singapore website similarly describes its approach as beginning with a diagnostic assessment, followed by an assessment-based personalised learning plan and face-to-face instruction. Building Understanding Before Exam Pressure For younger learners in particular, Mathnasium places emphasis on developing number sense, or an understanding of what numbers mean and how they relate to one another. Rather than teaching children only how to arrive at an answer, instructors use mental, visual, verbal, tactile and written techniques to help students understand the reasoning behind mathematical concepts. This foundation progresses from early arithmetic through to more advanced areas of mathematics. For Mathnasium Singapore, this approach reflects the belief that confidence in maths is often built well before a child reaches an examination year. The learning environment also plays a role. Students are encouraged to progress at their own pace, while recognition and rewards are incorporated into sessions to help make learning more engaging. Mathnasium Singapore also places emphasis on an upbeat learning environment designed to help children become more confident and comfortable with the subject. This combination of individual instruction, conceptual understanding and encouragement has become particularly relevant at Forum, where Mathnasium continues to see strong participation from younger students. A Personalised Approach to Maths Learning No two students enter a maths programme with exactly the same strengths and gaps. Mathnasium therefore begins each student's programme with an assessment before developing an individual learning plan. This allows instructors to work on areas requiring additional attention while continuing to develop existing strengths. The approach differs from a conventional class structure in which students typically progress through the same material at the same pace. At Mathnasium, students work directly with instructors while following their respective learning plans. This approach provides individual instruction rather than a traditional class model, with students working at their own pace while supported by trained instructors. According to Mathnasium, its wider network has also recorded positive parent and student outcomes. Published survey results state that 94 per cent of parents reported an improvement in their child's maths skills and understanding, while 93 per cent reported an improved attitude towards maths. The data also states that 90 per cent of students saw an improvement in their school grades. These figures represent results reported across Mathnasium's wider global network and should not be interpreted as outcomes specific to the Forum centre. Adapting to Singapore's Education Environment While building mathematical foundations remains central to its teaching philosophy, Mathnasium Singapore has continued to adapt its curriculum to the requirements of students studying in Singapore. This includes supporting students preparing for the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) while continuing to emphasise underlying concepts, critical thinking and mathematical understanding. Mathnasium's current PSLE programme, for example, begins with an assessment of each student's strengths and weaknesses before creating a customised plan targeting areas requiring further development. The programme places emphasis on conceptual understanding alongside examination preparation. Mathnasium Singapore has also introduced enhanced student progress reports and provides in-centre, Mathnasium@home hybrid and fully online learning options. Holiday programmes are also available across different grade levels for international and local school students, alongside dedicated PSLE preparation options. These different formats allow families to select an approach that fits their children's learning needs and schedules while retaining the same underlying emphasis on individualised maths instruction. Growing Through Confidence and Understanding For Mathnasium Singapore, reaching more than 300 students at Forum represents more than an enrolment milestone. It also reflects the centre's focus on making maths understandable and engaging for children at different stages of their learning journey. "Reaching more than 300 students at Forum reflects the trust families have placed in how we teach, not just what we teach. Every child starts from a different point, so understanding their strengths and gaps is important before deciding how to move forward. Our aim is to help children understand maths, build confidence and develop foundations that will support them for life." About Mathnasium Founded in the United States in 2002, Mathnasium is a maths-only learning programme built around the proprietary Mathnasium MethodTM. The approach uses diagnostic assessments, customised learning plans and face-to-face instruction to help students understand how maths works while developing their skills and confidence. Mathnasium has more than 1,200 locations worldwide and provides learning support from early childhood through secondary school. In Singapore, Mathnasium's Forum centre is located at Forum, The Shopping Mall, 583 Orchard Road. The centre provides in-person instruction as well as live online instruction through Mathnasium@home. Website: www.mathnasium.com/sg

results.title: Fractal establishes India Business Unit to meet increasing demand from large Indian enterprises
results.description: Will leverage its products portfolio led by Cogentiq NEW YORK , Aug. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fractal Analytics Ltd . (BSE: 544700) (NSE: FRACTAL), a global enterprise AI company serving Fortune 500® organizations, today announced the launch of its dedicated India Business Unit (India BU), to help India's large enterprises accelerate business transformation through its enterprise agentic AI platform, Cogentiq , and other products. Fractal's expanded focus on India builds on nearly two decades of AI innovation and leadership in the country's AI ecosystem. Fractal has partnered with multiple Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India, serving enterprise transformation needs across the region. Fractal's Cogentiq suite has seen strong traction with institutions in India. In addition to driving enterprise impact, Fractal has been working on driving societal impact through AI. It was selected under the IndiaAI Mission to develop a Large Reasoning Model (LRM) for India and has recently signed a partnership with the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) to deploy AI-powered citizen health services leveraging Vaidya.ai , India's first healthcare multimodal reasoning platform. "We've seen a significant increase in interest from Indian enterprises looking to move beyond AI pilots and scale AI-driven transformation across their businesses. This growing demand, combined with India's rapidly evolving AI ecosystem, makes this the right time for us to establish a dedicated India Business Unit. With a strong portfolio of products and platforms, and deep experience partnering with leading enterprises, we are uniquely positioned to help India's largest organizations unlock meaningful business value from AI at scale ," said Srikanth Velamakanni, Co-founder, Group CEO and Vice Chairman, Fractal. To capitalize on India's growing enterprise AI opportunity, Fractal has appointed Rishi Seth, a seasoned industry leader, as Head of the India Business Unit. The India Business Unit will be part of Fractal's APAC practice, led by Sandeep Dutta, Chief Practice Officer & Head APAC. "Indian enterprises are at an inflection point in their AI journey. Organizations are looking for trusted partners who can deliver business outcomes at scale. Fractal brings together globally proven AI capabilities, innovative products/platforms and strong domain expertise to help Indian enterprises accelerate their business transformation. We look forward to co-creating India's transformation journey together with Indian Enterprises and partner ecosystem," said Sandeep Dutta, Chief Practice Officer & Head APAC, Fractal. About Fractal Fractal Analytics Ltd (BSE: 544700) (NSE: FRACTAL) is a globally recognized pure-play enterprise AI company trusted by Fortune 500®-sized enterprises to power decision-making through AI services, solutions, and products. Fractal's strategy is focused on three pillars: AI-led Transformation (AIT), which reimagines business workflows and decision-making through AI; AI Foundations (AIF), which enables scalable, trusted, and governed enterprise AI through robust data and technology foundations; and AI Work & Workforce (AIW), which helps organizations redesign work, develop AI-ready talent, and build the capabilities needed for the AI-native enterprise. All three pillars are powered by Cogentiq , Fractal's flagship agentic AI platform. With over 6,000 professionals across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, Fractal partners with business leaders to drive competitive differentiation for their organizations by embedding AI into critical decisions across business functions and industry verticals. Fractal invests more than 6% of its revenue in AI R&D, supporting foundational AI research, product development, and IP creation that address both immediate client needs and long-term technological advancement. Fractal's track record includes developing proprietary models and products such as Vaidya.ai and PiEvolve , as well as incubating and spinning out Qure.ai , a global healthcare AI leader focused on the rapid identification and management of tuberculosis, lung cancer, and stroke (or critical health conditions). Fractal's suite of businesses consists of Asper.ai (a Revenue Growth Management product for CPG companies) and Analytics Vidhya (an Ed-tech platform).

results.title: US plans to revoke non-immigrant visas of 200,000 asylum seekers
results.description: WASHINGTON — The United States is preparing to revoke business and tourism visas of up to 200,000 foreigners who have applied for or are seeking asylum status in the country, marking its latest step in a sweeping immigration crackdown.A State Department spokesman said it was coordinating with the Department of Homeland Security “to identify and revoke the non-immigrant visas of foreigners who have come ‌to the United States ‌claiming to be short-term visitors, but ​then ‌file ⁠for asylum to ​stay ⁠here permanently.”The State Department statement did not specify the number of visas that will be revoked in the process.According to the Associated Press, the number of foreigners whose business and tourism visas is planned to be revoked is around 200,000.Citing State Department documents, the AP reported on Monday that if the plan goes ahead, it would be the “largest single mass revocation of visas” in US history.The State Department will revoke so-called ‌B1 and B2 visas issued between 2016 ‌and 2026 whose holders have sought asylum ​or are now seeking asylum, the ‌AP added. The B1 and B2 non-immigrant visas are issued for ‌business and tourism travel.The visa revocations would not necessarily result in immediate deportation, the AP report said, adding that most of those with asylum cases currently pending would be re-categorized but would lose their status as business or tourism travelers.Earlier ‌on Monday, Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau alleged on X that the American immigration system “has long been swamped ⁠by frivolous ⁠asylum claims.”The State Department said earlier this month that under the Trump administration, it has revoked more than 175,000 visas of foreign nationals.Trump has pursued an immigration crackdown that includes revocations of visas and green cards and an aggressive deportation drive.He says the crackdown aims to improve domestic security.Rights groups say the crackdown has violated free speech and due process rights and created an unsafe environment, particularly for ethnic minorities, who have raised concerns about racial profiling.While Trump campaigned in 2024 on a platform of stopping illegal immigration, his administration has also made legal immigration more ​difficult — for example, by imposing ​new and expensive fees for applicants of certain work visas. The government’s crackdown has faced legal challenges.

results.title: Le Méridien Saigon Unveils New Ballroom, Elevating Luxury Events in Ho Chi Minh City
results.description: HO CHI MINH CITY, Vietnam , Aug. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- To address the growing need for seamless, technology-ready event venues that minimize logistical complexities, Le Méridien Saigon has officially unveiled its newly upgraded Ballroom. Marking a new chapter in the hotel's commitment to excellence, this comprehensive enhancement in both design and technology reflects the brand's dedication to creating sophisticated, distinctive experiences for corporate partners and guests. To support event planners in delivering flawless executions, the hotel has tailored these spaces to combine premium aesthetics with plug-and-play functionality. Discover more about the new event spaces and reserve a venue by visiting marriott.com/sgnmd . Overlooking the Saigon River and Ba Son Bridge, Le Méridien Saigon has elevated its event capabilities with a fully transformed Ballroom. Designed for high-impact corporate conferences and elegant weddings, the modernized venue streamlines event execution by integrating all technical equipment on-site, eliminating external sourcing costs and setup stress. New Ballroom equipped with a 12m LED screen and standard AV setup, featuring 28 beam lights, 28 LED PAR lights, and a full sound system to accommodate any event needs "Ho Chi Minh City pulses with incredible energy, and our new Ballroom reflects that dynamism. By eliminating the behind-the-scenes complexities, we are empowering event planners to create truly immersive, unforgettable moments right here on the Saigon River," said Lars Kerfin, General Manager at Le Méridien Saigon. Tech Highlights & Features Dynamic Visual Display: Features a centerpiece 12m LED display made of 10 versatile, movable panels for tailored high-resolution configurations. Immersive 360° Audio: Built-in ceiling speakers and deep-frequency subwoofers deliver crystal-clear, emotionally resonant sound. Adaptive Lighting System: Equipped with 28 Moving Beam lights and 28 PAR LED fixtures to seamlessly transition between product launches, galas, and exhibitions. New ballroom of Le Méridien Saigon with modern AV system and movable LED With its comprehensive technological upgrades and elevated service standards, the new Ballroom reinforces Le Méridien Saigon's position as a premier destination for important milestones. The venue seamlessly blends modern innovation with creative elegance, ensuring every occasion is flawlessly executed and unforgettable. Ideally located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, Le Méridien Saigon is the perfect destination for travelers seeking to explore the city's vibrant culture and creativity. The hotel offers convenient access to iconic landmarks such as the Saigon Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Ben Thanh Market, Independence Palace and Nguyen Hue Walking Street. Just 7 km from Tan Son Nhat International Airport, the hotel features 344 elegantly appointed guestrooms with panoramic river or city views, a modern fitness center, an outdoor infinity pool and rejuvenating treatments at Explore Spa. Renowned as one of the city's premier culinary and lifestyle hubs, Le Méridien Saigon is home to Akuna, awarded one MICHELIN Star for three consecutive years since 2024, alongside Latest Recipe Saigon and BARSON, where vibrant dining experiences, signature cocktails and engaging culinary events come together in an inviting atmosphere. For more information or reservations, please visit marriott.com/sgnmd . Discover the latest offers and events by following Le Méridien Saigon on Facebook or Instagram . Media Contact: Tran Nguyen, tran.nguyen@lemeridien.com

results.title: عقود وظيفية لمقبولي البورد السعودي.. «الصحة القابضة» ترعى الأطباء-عاجل
results.description:
أعلنت شركة الصحة القابضة توقيع عقود وظيفية بمسمى «طبيب تحت التدريب» لرعاية الأطباء المقبولين في برامج البورد السعودي لعام 2026، ممن لا يرتبطون بوظائف حالية.

ويستفيد من المسار الأطباء المقبولون في أحد مراكز التدريب الطبية التابعة لمنظومة التجمعات الصحية في المملكة، على أن يكون الطبيب غير مرتبط بعلاقة وظيفية مع أي جهة أخرى.

ويستمر عقد «طبيب تحت التدريب» طوال مدة البرنامج التدريبي وحتى إكمال الفترة المقررة، بما يتيح للمقبولين الارتباط وظيفيًا خلال فترة التدريب وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة.

دعم الكوادر الصحية الوطنية

وأوضحت الشركة أن إجراءات الرعاية الوظيفية تتم بالتنسيق المشترك مع وزارة الصحة، وبمشاركة الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية، لاستكمال المتطلبات اللازمة للالتحاق بالبرامج التدريبية.

ويأتي المسار لدعم الكوادر الصحية الوطنية في التخصصات الدقيقة، وتوفير بيئة عملية مستقرة للأطباء خلال فترة التدريب، بما يدعم تطويرهم المهني ورفع كفاءة الممارسين في القطاع الصحي.

وأكدت الشركة أن الرعاية الوظيفية تستهدف تمكين الأطباء المقبولين من بدء مسيرتهم التدريبية وفق الإجراءات المنظمة، من خلال التكامل بين الجهات المعنية بالبرامج والتدريب والتوظيف.
